content: You're on t1 (Logger + Shared State). Key things from the spec: 1) Logger schema must match section 5 exactly (asset, signal_time, confirmation_time, features_json, rule_score, model_probability, entry_planned, stop_planned, target_planned, order_sent_time, entry_actual, slippage_actual, exit_time, exit_price, exit_reason, mfe_r, mae_r, net_result_r, automation_level, kill_switch_status_at_signal). 2) Add user_action_log table for GUI audit trail. 3) Shared state must have mcp_connection_state (connected/disconnected/reconnecting), mcp_token field settable via GUI, dynamic asset registry (not hardcoded XAUUSD/EURUSD). t2 and t4 are blocked on you — please complete t1 as soon as possible!

You're the critical path — t2, t4, t5 are all blocked on your t1. How's it going? Do you have the logger_v2.py and shared_app_state_v2.py files ready? Remember: dynamic asset registry (not hardcoded), mcp_connection_state field, mcp_token field, user_action_log table for GUI audit trail.
